preview: Saharsh Jain shares his interview experience for an internship at Wells Fargo, detailing the online test, technical interview, and HR rounds.
content: Wells Fargo Saharsh Jain B.Tech. IT 2018-22 STAGE 1 (Online Test on AMCAT) Duration - 1 hour 40 mins Can attempt questions in given order only and no negative marking SECTION 1: Verbal (15 minutes) 14 Questions on synonyms, correct grammatical errors, questions on passage. You might think that reading the whole passage will take time, so I should skip this quest. But there are 2-4 questions on that passage, so reading it once is worth it. Also once you skip a question you cannot roll back. Attempt all questions as there is no negative marking. SECTION 2: Aptitude (25 minutes) 13 Questions based on finance. Given passage with some tables and figures, 2-3 questions were asked on that. The question had jargons from financial world and I was not able to understand some :D SECTION 3: CODING (60 minutes) 2 Questions (Everyone had different questions) 1. Given an array of integers (B) of size ‘n’ and an integer ‘key’, output the resultant array (A). Resultant array is formed in this way: a. If key >= 0: Every element ai in resultant array is sum of next ‘key’ elements to bi b. If key < 0: Every element ai in resultant array is sum of previous ‘key’ elements to bi c. Note: Consider B as circular while taking next/previous elements Example: Input Output 5 3 4 2 -5 11 10 8 16 25 16 1 4 -2 1 3 4 2 6 3 4 7 I did this in O(N), passing 10/11 test cases 2. Given a list of locations of customers (xi, yi). The delivery boys take trips to serve the customers. His trips are of 3 types: a. Type 1: given x1 and x2 ...he serves those whose x lies in between x1 and x2 b. Type 2: given y1 and y2 ...he serves those whose y lies in between y1 and y2 c. Type 3: given x1 x2 y1 y2...he serves those whose x lies in between x1 and x2 and y lies in between y1 and y2 Given number of trips, trip type and required boundaries output floor(distance) between two nearest customers in that boundary Input: #customer xi yi for each customer #trip type and required parameters of that type Output: floor(dist) for each trip It was a very long question, I wasted most of my time reading it :( I first thought of sorting and doing binary search for the given trip type and then divide and conquer for nearest points. But I was short of time, so I tried brute force and still was not able to pass even the given test cases. It passed 2 test cases. STAGE 2 (Interview - Technical) 22 people were shortlisted for interview round It was on zoom, whiteboard was used for explaining and writing code 1. Introduce yourself. He then asked me to explain one of my projects, technology used 2. Explain OOPs. What data structures are you aware of, explain them (cross questions in between). Implement stack using linked list 3. What is virtual memory, thrashing, segmentation → I was not able to recall thrashing 4. TCP vs UDP → just gave basic difference 5. Number of ways to arrange 4 boys and 4 girls in circular table such that no two boys sit together 6. Given an array, output the array with first half in ascending order and second half in descending order → Solution I gave: sort the whole array and then reverse the later half, He told me to code the solution with sort function (I used merge sort) 7. Tell me different types of trees. Code the traversal techniques 8. Do you have any questions? → What technologies are used in Wells Fargo, your role there, etc. (Ask at least one) STAGE 3 (Interview - Technical + HR ….But for me it was just HR :D) 15 people were shortlisted for this round It was on zoom 1. Walk me through your resume 2. What are your short term and long term goals 3. What do you do in free time → Since it is lockdown right now, I just watch series/movies, or play with my siblings...else I hangout with my friends/cousins 4. Talking about lockdown, there is so much happening right now. Which news did you follow and what are your views about it → Change in education system, though it will take long to implement all of it but this first step was needed. Students getting to explore what they like, have practical/industry exposure in school days is great! 5. What do you know about Wells Fargo? 6. Why do you want to work with Wells Fargo, how will it help you? 7. What factors differentiate financial companies from others, like what is more important in a financial company? → Security in transactions and customer’s trust, maintaining confidentiality 8. Who are the competitors of Wells Fargo 9. There are two major roles in future - technical and tech + manager. Which would you choose? 10. What qualities do you look for in a leader? 11. Do you have any questions → What roles will be offered for interns, Will there be any round further → He replied: Yes, one HR round :) I was not expecting a HR round (people had technical questions on projects/dbms), but paying attention in their ppt helped (I used to take screenshots of important slides ;D) STAGE 4 (Interview - HR) 8 people were shortlisted for this round It was on zoom This round lasted 15 minutes. 1. Intro, how was your day/experience in previous interviews 2. What are your interests 3. Have you done anything in those fields 4. Who is the head of Wells Fargo 5. Any questions? → How is the work environment there, what do they see in interns during internship period, what is the future of interns…. All 8 were selected for 2 months internship Resources ● Internship Guide - CoC ● https://github.com/yash0530/InterviewPrepResources ● InterviewBit for practice ● GeeksforGeeks for everything :) Tips ● In between interview rounds I used to keep myself busy by watching youtube videos/blogs on things that I already knew. It helped me with confidence (kam se kam itna to aata h :D) and avoiding overthinking ● As you can see the questions in the test/interview were a bit easy. What I believe is these companies don’t only look for technical knowledge but they also see how confident/honest you are with your answers. They don’t expect you to know everything, just be calm and go with the flow All the best!!
